bugs.description: After creating an item the mutation invalidates the wrong React Query cache key (["users"] instead of ["items"]). The items list query is never refetched, so a newly created item does not appear until a manual reload, while an unrelated users query is needlessly refetched.

The await was dropped from the loginAccessToken call, so `response` is a Promise rather than the resolved token object. `response.access_token` is undefined, so the string 'undefined' (or undefined) is written to localStorage and the user is never actually authenticated even on correct credentials.

The `enabled` guard on the currentUser query was inverted (enabled: isLoggedIn() -> enabled: !isLoggedIn()). The current user is now fetched only while logged OUT and skipped while logged in, so `user` is always undefined for authenticated sessions, breaking every gate that depends on it.

`theme` was removed from the useEffect dependency array, so the effect that applies the theme class to <html> and subscribes to the system color-scheme listener only runs on mount. Switching theme updates state but never re-applies the DOM class or rebinds the listener with the new value — a stale-closure dependency bug.

The zod `.refine()` that checks new_password === confirm_password was removed from the Change Password schema. The client no longer validates that the two fields match, so a user who mistypes the confirmation submits a password they did not intend, with no error shown.

The '+ 1' was dropped from the 'Showing X to Y' range start, which uses a 0-based pageIndex. The footer now reads 'Showing 0 to N' on the first page instead of 'Showing 1 to N' — an off-by-one in the displayed row range.

The Save button's disabled condition was inverted (disabled={!form.formState.isDirty} -> disabled={form.formState.isDirty}). Save is now disabled exactly when there ARE unsaved changes and enabled when there are none, so the user can never submit an edited profile.

The 'omit empty password' guard was inverted (if (!submitData.password) -> if (submitData.password)). Now the password is deleted from the payload precisely when the admin DID type a new one, and an empty-string password is sent when the field was left blank — so admins can never set a password and may push an empty password to the API.

The items query limit was silently reduced from 100 to 10. Only the first 10 items are ever fetched, and because the table paginates client-side over whatever it received, users with more than 10 items silently lose access to the rest with no indication anything is missing.

form.reset() was removed from the Add User success handler. After creating a user the dialog closes but the form keeps the previous values, so reopening Add User shows the last submission's email/name/flags pre-filled instead of an empty form.

findings.issue: Condition inverted: was 'if (!submitData.password) delete' now 'if (submitData.password) delete'. A non-empty password is now stripped and an empty one is sent, breaking password updates.
After adding an item, the code invalidates the 'users' query instead of 'items'. The items list will never refresh after creation.
Password match validation (.refine) removed. Users can now submit mismatched new_password and confirm_password with no client-side error.
Save button disabled logic inverted: 'disabled={form.formState.isDirty}' disables when dirty (changed) and enables when clean, preventing users from ever saving edits.
'enabled: !isLoggedIn()' fetches current user only when NOT logged in. Logged-in users will never have their profile loaded, breaking the entire auth flow.
'await' removed from LoginService.loginAccessToken call. 'response' is now a Promise; accessing response.access_token returns undefined, breaking login token storage.
form.reset() removed on success. The form will retain stale values if the dialog is reopened, leading to confusing UX or accidental resubmission.
Pagination 'Showing X to ...' start value lost +1. On page 0, offset 0*size=0 is shown instead of 1, and on later pages the start number is off by one.
'theme' removed from useEffect dependency array. If theme changes externally the effect may not re-run, causing stale media-query listener behaviour.
Items fetch limit reduced from 100 to 10. This is a significant behaviour change; ensure pagination handles partial loads or this is intentional.
